raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 0
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misapplied basic physics facts, incorrectly claiming the neutron’s mass (~8.5e-32 kg) is less than the electron’s and concluding that the neutron has the least mass. In reality, electrons have the least mass (~9.11e-31 kg), while neutrons are slightly heavier than protons (~1.675e-27 kg). This conceptual/numerical error led to the wrong final answer and was delivered prematurely as “TASK_COMPLETE” without verification.
